text:
A gas is heated in a sealed container.
The volume of the container does not change.
What happens to the molecules of the gas?
A
The average distance between molecules increases.
B
The average kinetic energy of the molecules increases.
C
The mass of each molecule increases.
D
The volume of each molecule increases.

options.label: A
options.text: The average distance between molecules increases.

options.label: B
options.text: The average kinetic energy of the molecules increases.

options.label: C
options.text: The mass of each molecule increases.

options.label: D
options.text: The volume of each molecule increases.
